title: Суд во сне и отравление  (Dream Trial and Food Poisoning)

segments.t: Haunted by his accidental night with Eleonora, Denis has a nightmare in which a stern judge sentences him for infidelity. Meanwhile, with their wives away, Senya and Fedya suffer severe food poisoning and battle over the apartment bathroom.
Когда не можешь решить проблему, у тебя есть только один выход.
Забыть ее навсегда и
попытаться жить дальше.
Подсудимый Крылов Денис Андреевич, вы обвиняетесь в измене.
Но я не виноват!
Сейчас будет еще лучше.
В возбуждении отказать.
Живот прихватило.
Я в туалет там вешалка.
Потерпеть не мог хотя бы часик.
Хотя бы минут пять.
Когда наших сожителей дома не будет, будем бегать всю ночь.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Когда не можешь решить проблему, у тебя есть только один выход.
'When you cannot solve a problem, you only have one way out.' Even though when Eleonora cannot solve a problem Eleonora only have one way out, Denis keeps a steady face in front of Eleonora.
Забыть ее навсегда и
'To forget it forever and' Around the apartment and shift, Denis sets a calm, everyday tone with Eleonora.
попытаться жить дальше.
'try to live on.' Trying to live is how Denis lays out the situation for Eleonora.
Подсудимый Крылов Денис Андреевич, вы обвиняетесь в измене.
'Defendant Denis Andreyevich Krylov, you are accused of infidelity.' Once defendant Denis Andreyevich Krylov Denis is accused of infidelity, Eleonora can finally tell Denis what she means.
Но я не виноват!
'But it is not my fault!' Declaring that it is not his fault brings Denis's temper right to the surface. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Сейчас будет еще лучше.
'Right now it is going to get even better.' Saying that right now it is going to get even better is how Eleonora sets the tone with Denis.
В возбуждении отказать.
'Arousal denied.' Around the apartment and point, Eleonora sets a calm, everyday tone with Denis.
Живот прихватило.
'My stomach cramped up.' Around the apartment and truth, Senya sets a calm, everyday tone with Denis.
Я в туалет там вешалка.
'I need the toilet, it is a total nightmare in there.' Here needing the toilet it is a total nightmare in there sets up the next turn in their exchange.
Потерпеть не мог хотя бы часик.
'Could you not hold it for at least an hour?' Asking whether Denis not hold it for at least an hour is how Senya puts Denis on the spot.
Хотя бы минут пять.
'At least five minutes.' Between the apartment and the shift, Senya gives Denis a quick, grounded response.
Когда наших сожителей дома не будет, будем бегать всю ночь.

'When our housemates are not home, we will be running all night.' Senya mentions that when their housemates are not home they will be running all night so Denis sees what is at stake. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
